info.name: Market
info.summary: Browse, install and update apps from a local catalog inside ownCloud
info.description:
Easily manage ownCloud apps from within your ownCloud web interface. This BW-Tech fork ships with a fully self-contained, local app catalog (no external marketplace required) and a refreshed light UI with live search. Apps can be downloaded from any URL declared in `marketplace/apps.json` (for example GitHub releases).
This is a community fork maintained by BW-Tech GmbH for owncloud.online. Original code by ownCloud GmbH.
To use this application click on "Apps" in the top left corner and click on "Market" (cart icon) (Administrator privileges required).
